messages:
Ravi: Quick check-in after last night's latency incident. We need final owners for action items and decide whether to touch SLO text or only alerts.
Ellen: Short recap: spikes at p99 during nightly batching (02:00-03:00). Mitigations proposed: route batches to low-priority pool, improve KV cache hit rate, add CI perf tests.
Priya: I'll take the routing change (SRE-314). Plan: config change + 10% canary, roll by 2026-04-01.
Ravi: Assigned Priya -> SRE-314. Please include a dashboard panel for routed batch volume and latencies.
Priya: Will add tile to the eng-sre SLO dashboard and link it here.
Ellen: I'll own the KV cache work (INF-401). Target: prototype in 7 days, full rollout in 3 weeks.
Ravi: Good. For SLOs: legal/product said don't change SLA language. Ops recommendation: only relax monitoring thresholds temporarily while fixes land.
Priya: Makes sense. I'll update the alert threshold for p99 from 240ms -> 280ms for 14 days and add a runbook link. Not touching the SLO doc.
BuildBot: Alert modified: p99-latency-threshold updated by Priya; auto-revert scheduled in 14 days.
Ellen: Also adding a perf test to CI that simulates the batch window (CI-920). This should catch regressions in presubmit.
Ravi: Action summary:
- Priya: SRE-314 routing change + dashboard tile + temp alert (canary 2026-04-01)
- Ellen: INF-401 KV cache prototype -> rollout (3 weeks)
- Ellen: CI-920 perf test for batch window (in 1 sprint)
- Ravi: Draft escalation triggers for >2 spikes/week -> auto-create follow-up
Priya: I'll post the dashboard link and a short how-to after the canary config is live.
Ellen: If we still see >1% error-budget/day after 7 days post-rollout, schedule a retrospective with infra and model teams.
Ravi: Noted. I'll add the retrospective hold tentatively for 2026-04-10 09:00.
BuildBot: Weekly SLO scan scheduled: every Monday 05:00 UTC. Notification channel: #eng-sre.
Priya: PR for the routing config coming shortly.
Ellen: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and ticket links.
Ravi: Thanks all. Keep tickets updated; ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
